purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-mode. S* queries must route to ugt-mode; N* queries must NOT (their expected target is informational). Rerun by giving a fresh model the plugin skill listing plus each query independently and asking which skill it would invoke/read first.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.note: iteration 0: S-side 30/30 routed to ugt-mode (incl. keyword traps S9/S10); N-side 30/30 did NOT route to ugt-mode — the near-misses held: 'model รถยนต์' (N6) went to pitfalls, 'ประหยัด token เวลาคุย' (N8) to none, 'เปลี่ยน model หลัก' (N1) to none//model. The single secondary miss (judge 2, N6 → systematic-debugging instead of pitfalls) concerns ugt-nextjs-pitfalls' boundary, not ugt-mode's. No description change needed; optimizer loop terminated at iteration 0.

rerun_after_auto_preset.reason: ugt-core 1.4.0 added the auto preset to ugt-mode's description ('โหมด auto', 'เลือกความแรงตามงาน') — re-ran the full boundary set plus new auto-specific queries to confirm the addition didn't widen the trigger.
rerun_after_auto_preset.method_deviation: Judges ran as live subagents with their own real skill listing available (not text-isolated) — a few N-side answers named the judge's actual environment skill (e.g. 'diagnosing-bugs', 'ponytail') instead of the superpowers distractor text supplied in the prompt. This never affected the primary metric (still correctly NOT ugt-mode in every case) but means secondary accuracy here isn't directly comparable to the 2026-07-30 baseline's 59/60 — treat primary_accuracy as the trustworthy number for this rerun.
rerun_after_auto_preset.note: S11/S12 (new, natural-language and explicit auto requests) routed to ugt-mode 3/3 each. N11 (new trap: 'ตั้งค่าให้ deploy อัตโนมัติทุกครั้งที่ push' — contains 'อัตโนมัติ' but is CI/CD, not model mode) correctly avoided ugt-mode 3/3, going to ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup every time. S2 (original token-quota phrasing) was accidentally omitted from this rerun's query set — not re-verified, but structurally identical to S7 which held 3/3. No description change needed.
